lines: Middle Eastern crisis 2026 Iran war 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy and the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations report that an oil tanker has been damaged and caught fire off Khasab, Oman, while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz. (Al Jazeera)

Yemeni civil war Houthi–Saudi conflict The Saudi-led coalition launches airstrikes on Hodeidah, Yemen, targeting weapons smuggling used by the Houthis, and on targets in the Sanaa, Saada, and Taiz governorates. (AP) (Al Jazeera)
2026 Yemen offensives Yemeni government forces say they have conducted operations in the Al-Jawf, Marib, and Taiz governorates that have killed or injured 193 Houthi fighters. (Arab News)

Russo-Ukrainian war Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile strikes a field near the village of Nowy Lipowiec in Lublin Voivodeship, Poland, around 60 miles from a Coalition of the Willing training excercise. Air raid alerts are issued in Lublin and Podkarpackie Voivodeship. (AOL)
Haitian conflict Salvadoran military intervention in Haiti Two Salvadoran soldiers are killed and two more are injured when explosive they are handling detonate. (AP)
The governments of Haiti and El Salvador agree to build three new prisons to incarcerate Haitian gang members. (AP)
2026 Bayelsa boat disaster 30 people are dead and around 300 are missing after a ship carrying funeral goers capsizes in Bayelsa State, Nigeria.(Daily Trust)
2026 European unrest 2026 Italian unrest A general strike is held in Italy, with protests in multiple cities across the country. (Rai News in Italian)

Politics of Iraq Iraqi prime minister Ali al-Zaidi announces that an agreement has been reached with Kata'ib Hezbollah to establish a joint operations center and jointly station troops in Jurf al-Sakhar, south of Baghdad, after having threatened to send Iraqi security forces into the group's stronghold. (Al Jazeera) (Al Jazeera)
